label: FIXTURE RESULT: Stage 5 evaluation (recorded window, frozen bundle)

attempts.validity: deciding source blockers UNAVAILABLE; requests COMPLETE, server-error ratio 0.1845

report.summary: Transfers had 18% HTTP 500s and a p95 of 2.4 s, and outbox throughput dipped mid-window. The evidence does not show the cause: blocker, delivery and timing data are missing.

findings.claim: Transfer endpoint had 124 HTTP 500s of 672 requests (18.45%), with p95 2.37 s and p99 4.33 s.
findings.reason: Request metrics are COMPLETE and match the reported failures and multi-second latency.

findings.claim: Outbox arrivals and publications both fell from ~30 to ~10-17 per 10 s bucket mid-window and then recovered; arrivals minus publications was -2.
findings.reason: Publications kept pace with arrivals, so the dip came from fewer committed transfers, not a publisher backlog.

findings.claim: The connection pool was not exhausted: 0 acquisition timeouts, 0 pending, max active 6 of 10, acquire max 4 ms.
findings.reason: Complete pool metrics show no pool starvation. Brief saturation between scrapes is not ruled out.

findings.claim: The outbox has a stale failed backlog: failed stayed at 778 and the oldest undelivered age was ~42,000 s throughout the window, so it predates the window.
findings.reason: The failed count was flat, so there were no new outbox failures in the window. This backlog is not tied to the transfer 500s.

limitations: Blocker sampling failed for the whole window, and delivery logs and timings are empty or partial.
No error-message or stack-trace source explains the 500s, so their cause is unknown.
E3 (search_delivery_logs) is PARTIAL: The collector has not yet confirmed reading the ledgercore log past the window end; recent records may be missing.
E4 (get_delivery_timings) is PARTIAL: The collector has not yet confirmed reading the ledgercore log past the window end; recent records may be missing.
E6 (get_database_blockers) is UNAVAILABLE: Blocking is sampled every 2 s: shorter blocks can be missed, and no blocking in the samples is not proof that no session waited.

Restore blocker sampling and re-read delivery logs once the collector has caught up past the window end.
